1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Join a three-surface route with one scramble and one elevation change.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Join four surfaces after two scramble moves, with one additional opening facing an unjoined edge.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Rebuild a five-surface route with two elevation changes and three initial scramble moves.

4.label: hard
4.summary: The reference loft: seven route surfaces, three elevation changes, two additional unjoined openings, and four initial scramble moves.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: All eight modules form the target route, with five actual elevation changes and three additional unjoined openings. Six initial scramble moves do not imply a six-move minimum.

simplified.summary: Choose any module to attempt a slide into the empty rail, or any numbered surface to attempt a step. Proxies do not filter, disable or identify legal moves.

full.summary: Drag a module to the empty rail position and click the adjacent visible walkway surface to move the carrier.
